summary: Karyopharm Therapeutics filed a routine Item 8.01 8-K on August 31, 2026, disclosing submission of a supplemental New Drug Application to the FDA seeking Accelerated Approval for XPOVIO (selinexor) plus ruxolitinib in myelofibrosis. The company requested Priority Review, which if granted could yield a six-month review; FDA filing acceptance and review timelines are expected in Q4 2026 after the 60-day filing review. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, stake, price, or transaction mechanics are stated. This is a regulatory pipeline update, not a special situation; watch FDA acceptance and the SVR35 surrogate-endpoint question.
